kashika: परशब्दोऽतिशये वर्तते। संनिकर्षः प्रत्यासत्तिः। परो यः संनिकर्षो वर्णनामर्धमात्राकालव्यवधानं स संहितासंज्ञो भवति। दध्यत्र। मध्वत्र। संहिताप्रदेशाः — <<संहितायाम्>> [[६.१.७२]] इत्येवमादयः॥
kashikaEnglish: The closest proximity of sounds (half a mātrā apart) is called saṃhitā (connected speech).
englishShort: Extreme closeness of letters is called संहिता.
englishFull:
The closest proximity of sounds — with no more than half a मात्रा of pause — is called संहिता.

**Effect:** When sounds are in संहिता, sandhi rules apply.

**Example:** दधि + अत्र → दध्यत्र (sandhi applies)

**Without संहिता:** Each word pronounced separately, no euphonic change.
